sloka: स जीर्णं मानुषं देहं परित्यज्य पिता हि न: ।दैवीमृद्धिमनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम् ॥ २.१०५.३७॥
transliteration: sa jīrṇaṁ mānuṣaṁ dehaṁ parityajya pitā hi na: ।daivīmṛddhimanuprāpto brahmalokavihāriṇīm ॥ 2.105.37॥

translations.english: Our father, king Dasaratha, abandoned the wornout mortal body, and obtained divine prosperity of wandering in the world of Brahma.
